mapper.sql: BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, FSUBJECT_ID as fsubjectId, BAL_FLAG as balFlag, SUBJECT_TYPE as subjectType, SUBJECT_LEVEL as subjectLevel, ACC_QUA_FLAG as accQuaFlag, ACC_INT_FLAG as accIntFlag, OVERDRAWN_FLAG as overdrawnFlag, BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE as baseSubjectNature, GEN_DETSUB_FLAG as genDetsubFlag, CCY as ccy, SUBJECT_INTERNAL_CODE as subjectInternalCode, SUBJECT_HAND_FEL_CODE as subjectHandFelCode, CREATE_USER as createUser, CREATE_DEPT as createDept, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_USER as updateUser, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime
mapper.select: WITH temp as( SELECT b.HAND_CODE ,listagg(b.HAND_CODE_VALUE,',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.HAND_CODE_VALUE ) AS value FROM BOK_SUBJECT_HAND_VALUE b WHERE b.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND b.SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo} AND b.HAND_CODE != #{default} GROUP BY HAND_CODE ORDER BY b.HAND_CODE ) SELECT bs.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, bs.SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, bs.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, bs.FSUBJECT_ID as fsubjectId, bs.BAL_FLAG as balFlag, bs.SUBJECT_TYPE as subjectType, bs.SUBJECT_LEVEL as subjectLevel, bs.ACC_QUA_FLAG as accQuaFlag, bs.ACC_INT_FLAG as accIntFlag, bs.OVERDRAWN_FLAG as overdrawnFlag, bs.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE as baseSubjectNature, bs.GEN_DETSUB_FLAG as genDetsubFlag, bs.CCY as ccy, bs.SUBJECT_INTERNAL_CODE as subjectInternalCode, bs.SUBJECT_HAND_FEL_CODE as subjectHandFelCode, bs.CREATE_USER as createUser, bs.CREATE_DEPT as createDept, bs.CREATE_TIME as createTime, bs.UPDATE_USER as updateUser, bs.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, nvl(b.HAND_CODE_VALUE,null) AS typeDefault, h.HAND_CODE type1, temp.value type2 FROM BOK_SUBJECT bs LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_HAND_VALUE b ON b.BOOKSET_ID = bs.BOOKSET_ID AND b.SUBJECT_NO = bs.SUBJECT_NO AND b.HAND_CODE = #{default} LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_INTERNAL_HAND h ON h.BOOKSET_ID = bs.BOOKSET_ID AND h.SUBJECT_INTERNAL_CODE = bs.SUBJECT_INTERNAL_CODE AND h.HAND_CODE != #{default} LEFT JOIN temp ON temp.HAND_CODE = h.HAND_CODE where bs.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND bs.SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo} ORDER BY h.HAND_CODE desc
SELECT SUBJECT_NO code,SUBJECT_NAME name,SUBJECT_NAME shortName,SUBJECT_NO hidCode,SUBJECT_NAME linkValue FROM BOK_SUBJECT

to_number(subject_level) >= ( select DISTINCT to_number(SUBJECT_LEVEL) from BOK_SUBJECT where SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo} )
